title: SetupMintedPayload

step.description: A step of the milestone-1 checklist, registered or not, each with the label every client names it by: account (Account), carry-over (Carry over), your-machines (Your machines), forges (Forges), key-manager (Key manager), memory-bank (Memory bank), skills (Skills), instructions (Instructions), browser (Browser), permissions (Permissions), appearance (Appearance).

kind.description: The kind of item a result's action applies to: account (a provider account), forge-account, key-manager-connection, tool (a managed tool), skill-source, chrome (a paired Chrome), session (an authoring session), bank (a memory bank), denylist-section, or environment.

id.description: The item's id, as the methods behind its action name it: an account's id, a forge account's origin, a denylist section's name, a session's id.

label.description: The item as a person reads it, for the client to name beside the action.

subject.description: The subject chosen when minting, or null when the call named none.

variant.description: Which of an LLM step's prompts a minted session starts with: first, which authors the step's artefact, or revise, which revises the one there.

description: The LLM step, subject and prompt variant that minted this session.
